newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela oil investment funds seen delayed.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela oil investment funds seen delayed.

text.p: The domestic placement of bonds by Venezuela's oil investment fund, which offers Venezuelans their first chance to directly invest in large-scale oil projects, has been delayed until next year, a market source said.
"Last week the leaders of the placement told us it would be left until next year," said the source, who asked not to be identified.
The 60 billion bolivar ($128 million) placement, which will be used to raise funds for a $500 million Pequiven petrochemical project, was originally due to be made at the beginning of December.
The source said state-owned oil company PdVSA affiliate Sofip had delayed the issue until local markets have fully digested the share-offering of Venezuelan telephone company CANTV.
The government expects to place some 50 million CANTV shares, worth around $200 million, on the Caracas bolsa later this week.
